name: Carpaints Review
description: Cross-car carpaints catalog review. Validates that the BMW carpaint catalog has no shared-id collisions with non-BMW slices, that every required key (id, name, finish, roughness, metallic, base_color, clearcoat) is present, and that operator eyes-on the rendered swatch pass approves the visual.
dod_items: No carpaint id collisions across BMW IDCevo slices
All required keys present per sg_rules_live.json
Roughness / metallic / clearcoat ranges within tolerance
Visual swatch render approved by reviewer

checks.description: Pull the checker readiness table; the carpaints checker entry must report state='ready' for this workflow to proceed.
